Krumm misplaces an eyeball for the seventh time in a week, and decides what he really needs is a head. Ickis' boasting gets the better of him after he sits through a cutesy movie, just to prove that he can.

Ickis, Krumm, and Oblina pick a mild-mannered Englishmen to scare, thinking it will be a piece of cake. A wacky radio DJ announces that $50,000 has been hidden in the dump. Soon humans are swarming there and the monsters can't get rid of them.

Ickis, Krumm, and Oblina discover an old sixteen milimeter B movie in the dump, which they watch constantly despite the Gromble's protests. Ickis falls head over heels in love when he spots the screeching hook-nosed Judy from a Punch and Judy show.

Ickis is given the job of polishing The Gromble's sacred Amulet of Enfarg, a medal given to the most honored of monsters. When Krumm loses his pit hairs as the result of a prank, Ickis vows to do anything to get him his hair back.

When Ickis runs away fom the Academy he falls in with an old bluesman who cannot be scared because he's blind. The Snorch, tired of not being able to communicate, gets a new voicebox installed by Dr. Buzz which gives him a beautiful speaking voice.
Ickiss accidently eats a chocolate Easter bunny. The human food gives him a bad case of sleepscaring -- the monster equivalent of sleepwalking. A new transfer student arrives at the dump.
